label.desc: Full paths to text files containing run and target data. Labels are 10x10 patches representing the stimuli shown to the subject: 20 random labels, 12 figure labels (letters and shapes).

func.desc: Full paths to 4D nifti files with :term:`BOLD` data. 20 random scans (usually used for training) and 12 figure scans (usually used for testing).

mask.desc: Full Path to 3D nifti file that defines target volume in visual cortex

mask_roi.desc: List of full paths to 3D nifti file to images with specific data ('RH' for right hemisphere, 'LH' for left hemisphere, 'Vxxx' denote visual areas)

background.desc: Full path to nifti file containing a background image usable as a background image for miyawaki images.
